verdict.rationale: Sill's own GitHub README documents an opt-in virtual display (off by default) on the Mac host. It moves the streamed window onto a display of its own so the window keeps updating when other windows cover it, which is the core of the story. missing for 10: evidence that the virtual display keeps rendering when the Mac runs headless (no physical monitor), in-depth docs on configuring the virtual display, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
